lines.zh: 咕噜噜，我来助你一臂之力！
lines.en: Rumble, let me lend a hand!
Boom boom boom, Gruzzorlug Cannonner!
I need iron and fire, help me!
Move, don't block my path!
My cannonballs are no joke!
Watch out, I'm not dumb!
Bang bang bang, my cannonballs!
Boom! My cannon power!
Stay back, I'll retaliate!
Roar, my cannon thunder!

lines.zh: 扛着炮管，在岩道里挪步。
lines.en: Hauling my cannon through the stone tunnel.

lines.zh: 靴底碾过碎石，咕噜作响。
lines.en: Boots grinding gravel with a grumble.
I wait here for a chance.
I hide and observe.
I won't show easily.

lines.zh: 我需要找到合适的目标。
lines.en: I need a suitable target.
I'm looking for an opportunity.
I'm ambushing here.
I keep my cannon aimed at the cave mouth.
I'm ready here.
I'm ready to act.
I wait here for enemies.

lines.zh: 擦着炮口，等一个好时机。
lines.en: Polishing the muzzle, waiting for the right moment.
Tamping powder tight, humming a tune.
Counting my shells; not one is missing.

lines.zh: 靠着岩壁打盹，锤子还抱着。
lines.en: Napping by the rock wall, still hugging my hammer.
There, that's my target!
It's a player, I'm coming!
I've got my aim! Attack!
Watch my cannonballs!
My barrel is already polished.
I'll let you taste my cannon!
Short barrel, worse aim.
Player, you can't escape!
I'll bomb you with my cannon!
Watch my cannonballs hit you!

lines.zh: 矮人的眼睛，专瞧高处的人。
lines.en: A dwarf's eyes look up at tall folk.
That armor of yours fits my muzzle nicely.

lines.zh: 先量量你的距离，再开炮。
lines.en: Let me measure your distance, then fire.
Hold still, I am weighing you.
You stepped on my powder trail.
Your height is just right for one shot.
I see the iron at your belt.
The light in your eyes looks like a fuse.

lines.zh: 震耳欲聋的巨响中，我摇摇欲坠。
lines.en: The deafening boom makes me wobble.

lines.zh: 笨拙身躯受伤，行动迟缓。
lines.en: My clumsy body is injured, moving slowly.

lines.zh: 我笨拙的身躯受了伤，喘息不已。
lines.en: My clumsy body is injured, gasping.

lines.zh: 伤痛拖慢了我笨拙的步伐。
lines.en: Pain slows my clumsy steps.

lines.zh: 笨拙中，我摇摇晃晃，痛苦不已。
lines.en: My clumsiness makes me stagger, in pain.
My injured steps are heavy.
My clumsy steps stagger.

lines.zh: 受伤的笨拙脚步声，回荡在这片废墟。
lines.en: My injured, clumsy footsteps echo in the ruins.

lines.zh: 我笨拙的身躯承受不了更多的伤痛。
lines.en: My clumsy body can’t handle more pain.

lines.zh: 笨拙中，我感到一阵剧痛。
lines.en: Clumsy pain pierces me.

lines.zh: 矮人敲击炮管，试图吸引你靠近。
lines.en: The Gruzzorlug taps its cannon, trying to lure you closer.

lines.zh: 你被矮人的笑声吓到，但它们并未注意到你。
lines.en: You're startled by the dwarf's laughter, but they don't notice you.

lines.zh: 它用粗糙的手掌拍打你，试图让你接近炮台。
lines.en: It slaps you with its rough palm, trying to get you near the cannon.

lines.zh: 矮人炮兵发出低沉的咕噜声，好像在寻找食物。
lines.en: The Gruzzorlug makes a low growl, as if seeking food.

lines.zh: 它挥动笨拙的炮兵锤，吸引你注意。
lines.en: It swings its clumsy hammer, drawing your attention.

lines.zh: 矮人炮兵似乎对周围的环境不感兴趣。
lines.en: The Gruzzorlug seems uninterested in its surroundings.

lines.zh: 你被它的炮兵服装吓到，但并非敌人。
lines.en: You're startled by its cannon uniform, but it's not an enemy.

lines.zh: 它发出轻微的炮击声，让你感到不安。
lines.en: It makes a faint cannon firing sound, unsettling you.

lines.zh: 矮人炮兵试图用友好的方式接近你。
lines.en: The Gruzzorlug tries to approach you in a friendly way.

lines.zh: 它看起来对食物充满好奇，试图寻找。
lines.en: It seems curious about food, trying to find some.

lines.zh: 你和笨拙矮人炮兵的炮管相撞。
lines.en: You collide with the Gruzzorlug's cannon.

lines.zh: 炮兵的炮管差点砸中你。
lines.en: The cannon almost hits you.

lines.zh: 矮人的炮兵锤险些打中你。
lines.en: The dwarf's cannon hammer nearly hits you.

lines.zh: 炮兵的炮管与你擦肩而过。
lines.en: The cannon brushes past you.

lines.zh: 你撞上了矮人炮兵的炮台。
lines.en: You run into the Gruzzorlug's cannon platform.

lines.zh: 炮兵的炮管在你身边震动。
lines.en: The cannon shakes near you.

lines.zh: 你和矮人的炮兵锤差点碰上。
lines.en: You nearly collide with the dwarf's cannon hammer.

lines.zh: 炮兵的炮管差点撞到你。
lines.en: The cannon almost collides with you.

lines.zh: 你躲开了矮人炮兵的炮管。
lines.en: You dodge the Gruzzorlug's cannon.

lines.zh: 炮兵的炮管险些与你相撞。
lines.en: The cannon almost collides with you.
It growls lowly, seeking a mate.

lines.zh: 笨拙矮人炮兵发出求偶声。
lines.en: The Gruzzorlug makes a mating call.

lines.zh: 它似乎在寻找自己的配偶。
lines.en: It seems to be looking for its mate.

lines.zh: 它发出求偶的声音，希望能找到伴侣。
lines.en: It makes a mating sound, hoping to find a partner.

lines.zh: 矮人炮兵发出寻找伴侣的声音。
lines.en: The Gruzzorlug makes a sound to find a mate.

lines.zh: 它在荒野中发出求偶声。
lines.en: It makes a mating call in the wilderness.

lines.zh: 笨拙矮人炮兵在夜里发出求偶声。
lines.en: The Gruzzorlug makes a mating call at night.
It's looking for its own mate.

lines.zh: 笨拙矮人炮兵发出求偶的低吼。
lines.en: The Gruzzorlug makes a low mating call.
It searches for a mate in the wilderness.

lines.zh: 沉重的炮弹在地上滚动
lines.en: Heavy cannonball rolls on the ground

lines.zh: 矮人的手笨拙地拾起弹药
lines.en: Dwarf's clumsy hand picks up ammo

lines.zh: 炮兵低声咒骂着拾起弹药
lines.en: Cannoneer mumbles to himself, picking up ammo

lines.zh: 沉重的炮弹被笨拙地拾起
lines.en: Heavy cannonball clumsily picked up
Clumsy dwarf picks up a cannonball

lines.zh: 矮人炮兵笨拙地拿起炮弹
lines.en: Gruzzorlug cannonier picks up a cannonball clumsily
Picks up a heavy cannonball

lines.zh: 矮人炮兵拾起一枚炮弹
lines.en: Cannoneer picks up a cannonball
Clumsily picks up a cannonball

lines.zh: 笨拙矮人拾起一个炮弹
lines.en: Clumsy dwarf picks up a cannonball
Aim at distant prey

lines.zh: 笨拙矮人调整炮口瞄准
lines.en: Clumsy dwarf adjusts cannon to aim

lines.zh: 笨拙矮人瞄准敌方生物
lines.en: Clumsy dwarf aims at the enemy
Cannoneer aims at the prey
Clumsy dwarf prepares to aim
Aim at the next target
Aim at a nearby enemy

lines.zh: 笨拙矮人瞄准远处的敌人
lines.en: Clumsy dwarf aims at a distant enemy
Clumsy dwarf aims at the prey
Aim at the target

lines.zh: 炮口抬起来，对着那个家伙。
lines.en: Muzzle up, pointed at that one.

lines.zh: 火药装好了，就等一声令下。
lines.en: Powder packed, just waiting for the word.

lines.zh: 矮人的准头，从不靠运气。
lines.en: A dwarf's aim never leans on luck.

lines.zh: 那个跑得最快的，先轰他。
lines.en: The fastest one gets the first shot.
You moved first, so do not blame me.
Bipod set, target in the sights.
My cannon turns slowly, clumsy but true.
Aim at moving target

lines.zh: 笨拙矮人瞄准正在移动的目标
lines.en: Clumsy dwarf aims at a moving target
Aim and acquire
Aim at a stationary target

lines.zh: 笨拙矮人瞄准并锁定目标
lines.en: Clumsy dwarf aims and acquires the target
Acquire a stationary target
I brace the cannon and aim at you.

lines.zh: 引信嗤嗤地烧，你听见了吗？
lines.en: Hear the fuse hissing?
Three steps closer and I light it.

lines.zh: 别躲石头后，炮弹会拐弯。
lines.en: Do not hide behind stone; my shell finds a way.
My muzzle keeps following you.

lines.zh: 你数到三了吗？我等不及。
lines.en: Have you counted to three? I cannot wait.

lines.zh: 铁与火，都压进这一发了。
lines.en: Iron and fire, packed into this one shot.
The sight line rests on your chest.
Run, and let us see who is faster.
I have practiced this shot all my life.
Steady hands, steady heart, steady cannon.
Dull thud from the dwarf hammer!
Gruzzled dwarf swings the huge hammer!
Hammer swing, stone fragments fly!
Struck by the heavy hammer, it feels dull.
Gruzzled dwarf delivers a hammer blow!
Hammer impact, shakes the ground!
Hammer slams the ground, boom!
Dwarf swings hammer with great force!
Struck hard, pain is intense!
Dwarf swings hammer, with great noise!
The barrel makes a club for your skull!
One dwarf hammer splits even stone!
Powder grit in your face!
Do not crowd me, my barrel is still hot!
Taste a fist in an iron glove!
I will load you as the next shell!

lines.zh: 笨拙矮人炮兵从岩缝中走出！
lines.en: Gruzzorlug cannonier emerges from the rock crevice!

lines.zh: 岩壁裂开，笨拙矮人炮兵现身！
lines.en: Rock cracks, gruzzorlug cannonier appears!

lines.zh: 矮人炮兵自岩洞中走出！
lines.en: Dwarf cannonier steps out from the cave!

lines.zh: 岩缝裂开，笨拙矮人炮兵现身！
lines.en: Rock seam splits, gruzzorlug cannonier appears!

lines.zh: 笨拙矮人炮兵从洞中走出！
lines.en: Gruzzorlug cannonier steps out from the cave!

lines.zh: 矮人炮兵从岩壁中走出！
lines.en: Dwarf cannonier emerges from the rock face!

lines.zh: 洞中裂开，笨拙矮人炮兵现身！
lines.en: Cave splits, gruzzorlug cannonier appears!

lines.zh: 矮人炮兵从洞穴中走出！
lines.en: Dwarf cannonier steps out from the cave!

lines.zh: 火药味先到，我随后就到！
lines.en: The smell of powder comes first; I follow!

lines.zh: 从矿道深处，我拖着炮出来！
lines.en: Out of the deep shaft, dragging my cannon!

lines.zh: 矮人的锤声，敲醒了岩层！
lines.en: A dwarf's hammer woke the stone!

lines.zh: 炮车碾过碎石，轰隆登场！
lines.en: My gun carriage rolls over gravel, loud and proud!
I brought thirty pounds of powder!

lines.zh: 岩洞的回声，就是我的礼炮！
lines.en: The cave echo is my salute!
Dwarf cannoneer, reporting above ground!
Let me set the cannon first, then say hello!

lines.zh: 洞顶落灰了，那是我来了！
lines.en: Dust falls from the ceiling: that is me arriving!
Iron and fire come up with me!
The flames burn me!

lines.zh: 我从高处跌落，伤痕累累。
lines.en: I fell from a height, battered.
Struggling underwater.

lines.zh: 爆炸撕裂了我的笨拙身躯。
lines.en: The explosion ripped through me.
Hit, I fall clumsily.
The magic burns me.

lines.zh: 饥饿使我变得笨拙而虚弱。
lines.en: Starvation weakens my clumsy form.

lines.zh: 闪电击中我，我浑身一震。
lines.en: Lightning strikes, jolting me.
Torn apart in the void.
